Messages.Author: take...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
1. Can "Delaying tactics" be played at any time of a political action?
I mean, a vampire plays a political card, he uses bewitching oration,
telepatic vote counting, etc. Another player can use Delaying tactics
at that moment or it must be only after the first card has been played?

2. Vampire A (a Malkav for example) is bleeding, his prey attempt to
block, Vamp A plays stealth, Vampire B declines to block and plays
deflection, is it legal?????????

Thanks.
El Toreador

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.
